title: Build the grouped G matrix for the NFDS model — build_gnfds
text: G Raw presence/absence matrix, one row per isolate (row names sample accessions), one column per locus. meta_clean Metadata group column, e.g. reweight_carriage()$meta_clean_groups. xt Grouped x(t), e.g. reweight_carriage_uncertainty(). pre_years Pre-vaccine years ("pre2009" frequency). post_years Post-vaccine years ("post2011" frequency). all_years years used year--year variance. min_freq, max_freq Loci pre-vaccine frequency outside range left model.

title: Build the grouped G matrix for the NFDS model — build_gnfds
